scope: Notes workspace UI v1 in the native workbench: list, filters, search, detail, text selection, native context menus, copy actions, source states, full-body read state and narrow layout. Fixture data only; not an installed plugin and not connected to Core.

tests.typecheck: nsh check App.tsx passed with pinned types
names: a row opens its detail, and Escape returns to the list
the row context menu offers read actions and copies a citation
the missing source row says so and cannot open a page
a truncated note reads its complete body on request
keyboard moves the selection and copies the focused note
the narrow layout returns to the list and keeps the filter

interactions.context_menu: native Menu.popup on right click; row selected first; disabled edit/delete with reasons
interactions.selection: TextView selectable with selection toolbar (copy selection, copy as citation, clear)
interactions.keyboard: up/down, enter, mod+c, mod+shift+c, mod+f, shift+f10, escape
interactions.copy_formats: quote, note, markdown citation with document title and page
interactions.narrow: list/detail switch under 1120pt with filter and selection preserved

not_verified: formal plugins/notes package: manifest, signature, install/authorize/disable/uninstall
real Core data through the public notes.read capability
public capability wire, Host budgets and pagination cursors
real-window right click, drag selection and Shift+F10 (headless covers behavior)
IME, assistive technology, other platforms, performance and native resource release
